composition_code: compose_documents joins the units of one slot with a newline, so each slot is one paragraph; the exploratory and secondary supplement slots keep a blank line between blocks
a dotted Discussion sub-slot (DS02.records, DS06.reading) is a further paragraph after the same marker; DS10-join appends to the fixed DS10 paragraph
the C1 headline joins the opening CN01 question when the marker follows a blank line
the X3-X7 supplement is input after sections/supplement-exploratory-x1-x2, so the order is X1a/X2, X5, then X3-X7
the display includes compare with the joined P1 paragraph
